opinions.text:
*902On motions for leave to file complaints.

The motions for leave to file complaints are granted and process is ordered to issue returnable on or before September 1, next.

Mr. Justice Jackson took no part in the consideration or decision of these applications. Price Daniel, Attorney General of Texas, argued the cause for the defendant in No. 14. With him on the brief were J. Chrys Dougherty and Jesse P. Luton, Jr., Assistant Attorneys General.
